> [!WARNING]
> **No longer maintained.** 1.x gets no updates and no weekly security rebuilds any more. Please switch to `:2`: in `compose.yaml`, change `ghcr.io/dropnook/dropnook:1` to `ghcr.io/dropnook/dropnook:2`, then *Compose Up*. Without users, Drop works exactly as before — your files, texts, links and PIN stay as they are. See [Dropnook 2.0](https://github.com/dropnook/dropnook.app/releases/tag/v2.0.0).

**Dropnook 1.1** — two small things that you use every day.

* **☀ and ☾ in the header.** Light or dark by hand; a second click on the chosen one goes back to automatic, as the system. Each browser remembers its choice.
* **Open it on another device with a QR code.** The new button in the header (on computers and tablets) shows Drop's address as a QR code: point the phone's camera at it, and Drop opens there. Home network only — `drop-share` has nothing of it.

Nothing changes in `compose.yaml`; with `:1` the update comes like any other.
